sbd_device.description: Primary shared disk device used for SBD fencing (e.g., a persistent reservation-capable SCSI-3 device).

sbd_devices.description: Additional shared disk devices (optional). If provided, overrides SBD_DEVICE.

sbd_watchdog_ticks.description: Number of seconds the watchdog will wait before panicking the node if no-one tickles it (SBD_WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT).

sbd_retries.description: Unused in this template (SBD does not expose a direct retries parameter in its default config).

sbd_delay_start.description: Seconds to delay SBD startup (SBD_DELAY_START); can be 'no', 'yes', or an integer (seconds).

sbd_timeout_start.description: Seconds to wait for SBD to stop gracefully before forcing a reboot (not directly configurable in this config file; handled by systemd TimeoutStartSec).

sbd_timeout_stop.description: Seconds to wait for SBD to stop during shutdown before forcing reboot (not directly configurable in this config file; handled by systemd TimeoutStopSec).

sbd_enabled.description: Unused in this template (SBD is always active if configured); SBD_PACEMAKER=yes controls pacemaker integration.

sbd_pidfile.description: Unused in this template (SBD uses hardcoded PID file path).

sbd_debug_log.description: Unused in this template (no debug logging option in this config file).
